coverage: 2000-present: Ohio's weather actions are ORC 5502.22 proclamations, not filed/numbered EOs, and no complete list is published. Proclamations are added by hand from Ohio EMA's Gubernatorial Declarations History Chart (State Hazard Mitigation Plan, 2024, Appendix A), the Governor's announcements and news coverage; the chart says it may not include every declaration.
